node.statement: Choose the universal inclusion and ambient accuracy threshold so that C e<1 for C=max(C_1,C_2). Then BA and AB are invertible by their norm-convergent Neumann series. The map (BA)^(-1)B is a left inverse of A, while B(AB)^(-1) is a right inverse. Therefore A is a bounded linear bijection, and its inverse is the desired bounded bijection S_{R,T}->S_{R_0,T} direct-sum S_{R_1,T}.
